name: Indexarix SEO
author: bellicode

sections.description:
Indexarix SEO is a modular technical SEO plugin for WordPress focused on indexing, metadata, structured data, sitemaps, redirects and site diagnostics.

All features currently included in Indexarix SEO are free. The plugin does not require an account, license or subscription to use its local SEO features.

Indexarix is designed to give site owners a central place to manage technical SEO while avoiding duplicate output during migrations or when another SEO provider is still active.

SEO metadata and social sharing

Manage SEO titles, meta descriptions, canonical URLs and robots directives. Indexarix can also generate Open Graph and X/Twitter metadata with editor previews.

Structured data

Generate JSON-LD Schema for supported content and taxonomy contexts, including breadcrumbs through BreadcrumbList markup.

Indexing and sitemaps

Control indexing behavior by content type and manage XML sitemaps with image support. Indexarix also includes a Google News sitemap and an optional video sitemap with VideoObject data.

Redirects and 404 monitoring

Create and manage 301, 302, 307, 410 and 451 rules. The 404 Monitor classifies requests, helps identify relevant broken URLs and can suggest destinations for review without creating redirects automatically.

Diagnostics and migration

Run progressive site diagnostics, review technical SEO conditions and use Safe Migration tools when moving from another compatible SEO plugin. Indexarix never activates or deactivates another plugin automatically.

Optional modules

Optional modules include automatic image ALT fallback, IndexNow URL submission, video sitemap support and other tools that can be enabled only when needed.

Features

  • SEO title, meta description, canonical URL and robots directives.
  • Open Graph and X/Twitter metadata with editor previews.
  • JSON-LD Schema for supported content and taxonomies.
  • XML sitemap with image support.
  • Google News sitemap.
  • Optional video sitemap with VideoObject data.
  • Indexing controls by content type and taxonomy.
  • 301, 302, 307, 410 and 451 redirect management.
  • Redirect testing and CSV import/export.
  • Intelligent 404 monitoring with classification and priority.
  • Breadcrumbs and BreadcrumbList Schema.
  • Optional automatic image ALT fallback.
  • Optional IndexNow submission queue.
  • Progressive site diagnostics.
  • SEO analysis inside the WordPress editor.
  • Safe Migration workflow and compatible SEO importers.
  • Content extraction support for Gutenberg and selected page builders.
  • Conditional WooCommerce integration designed to coordinate Product Schema instead of duplicating it.
  • robots.txt tools, pre-flight checks and technical backup utilities.

External services

IndexNow

The IndexNow module is disabled by default. When an administrator enables it and URLs are queued, Indexarix sends the following information to the configured IndexNow endpoint:

  • the website host;
  • the IndexNow key and its verification URL (keyLocation);
  • the list of local public URLs queued for update notification.

The default endpoint is https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow. IndexNow is a third-party protocol used to notify participating search engines about added, updated or removed URLs. Requests are only sent when the module is enabled.

Service: https://www.indexnow.org/
Documentation: https://www.indexnow.org/documentation
Terms: https://www.indexnow.org/terms

Social profile test

The optional Test profiles admin tool only runs after an administrator action. It makes a safe HTTP request to profile URLs configured by that administrator to verify whether they respond.

Indexarix does not send those profile settings to BelliCode. Requests are sent directly from the WordPress site to the profile URL configured by the administrator. The destination website’s own terms and privacy policy apply.

Privacy

Indexarix SEO does not include proprietary telemetry and does not send usage data to BelliCode. Features that perform external requests are described in the External services section.
sections.installation:
1. Install Indexarix SEO from the WordPress Plugins screen or upload the plugin ZIP.
  2. Activate Indexarix SEO.
  3. Open Indexarix SEO > Panel and review the enabled modules.
  4. Open Settings to configure indexing, Schema, sitemaps and optional modules.
  5. If another SEO plugin is active, use the Safe Migration workflow before manually switching providers.
  6. After SEO or permalink changes, verify sitemap_index.xml, news-sitemap.xml and robots.txt.
  7. Run Diagnostics to review the technical state of the site.
sections.faq:
Are the features included in Indexarix SEO free?

Yes. All features currently included in the WordPress.org plugin are free and do not require an account, license or subscription.

Does Indexarix deactivate my current SEO plugin?

No. Activating or deactivating another plugin always remains an explicit WordPress administrator action.

Can I migrate from another SEO plugin?

Indexarix includes a Safe Migration workflow and compatible importers. The migration tools are designed to reduce duplicate public SEO output while you review the transition.

Does the 404 Monitor create redirects automatically?

No. It can classify requests and suggest possible destinations for review, but redirect rules are never created automatically from those suggestions.

Do I have to use IndexNow?

No. IndexNow is optional and disabled by default.

Does Indexarix include a Google News sitemap?

Yes. The Google News sitemap can be enabled for sites that publish eligible news content.

Can I control which content is indexed?

Yes. The Indexing Center provides controls for robots directives, Schema defaults and sitemap participation by supported content type.

Does Indexarix work with WooCommerce?

Indexarix includes conditional WooCommerce integration intended to coordinate Product Schema and avoid unnecessary duplicate structured data.
sections.changelog:
1.0.7

  • Initial public WordPress.org release of Indexarix SEO.
  • Restored the polished human-readable sitemap presentation without using a PHP <style> block or external stylesheet link.
  • Added the official Indexarix visual identity and high-contrast WordPress admin menu icon.
  • Preserved WordPress.org review hardening for request authorization, nonces, enqueue usage and translation packaging.
  • No intentional change to sitemap XML data, SEO metadata, redirects, diagnostics or editor analysis compared with the validated release base.
